brand.title: JAGRATA · Security Console
auth.detection: Detection only, with no automatic remediation.
auth.existing: Use your existing installation administrator. Account setup is managed locally.
auth.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
auth.rate: Too many login attempts. Retry later.
common.footer: Decisions are records. JAGRATA does not enable network enforcement.
overview.description: Understand detection activity. Investigate the evidence before taking action.
overview.noSeries: No scenarios represented in the observed alert window.
overview.noActivity: No activity in this observation window.
overview.unavailable: Stored alert observation unavailable. Counts are unknown.
overview.lowData: Limited observation window; bars show recorded counts, not a continuous traffic rate.
alerts.description: Inspect authoritative local alert records. Severity is not inferred.
alerts.unavailableDescription: The engine is stopped or no authoritative alert read succeeded. Counts are unknown.
alerts.emptyDescription: No matching records in this bounded observation. This does not prove there were no attacks.
alerts.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the source IP and copy it manually.
alerts.normalized: Normalized allowlisted record; no engine credentials or raw configuration.
alerts.boundary: JAGRATA is read only. Decision changes and network enforcement are disabled. Local protection policy is managed in Remediation Center. External enforcement status is unverified.
health.description: Process state and successful reads are observations, not guarantees of protection.
health.retrieved: Stored alerts were retrieved from the engine. Their timestamps remain historical.
health.noRead: No successful alert read. Current detection health cannot be established.
health.metricsMissing: Metrics unavailable. Source and parser health are unknown.
health.expand: Expand a series to inspect its counters. Cumulative counters do not establish recent log activity.
sources.description: Configure selected files. Verify parsing from engine evidence after an operator-approved deployment.
sources.pending: Pending operator apply: engine retains a file mount.
sources.emptyDescription: Add one SSH authentication or Nginx access log file. JAGRATA does not discover private logs.
sources.registryDistinction: This list contains only JAGRATA-managed registrations. Engine acquisition counters may include independently configured paths. An empty list does not mean acquisition failed; no engine source has been adopted or changed.
sources.stepOne: Select a single local file and validate its path. Validation does not read its contents or prove its format.
sources.stepTwo: Save a draft. Ask the local operator to generate and review a source deployment plan using the source setup guide.
sources.stepThree: The operator approves any new mounts or engine interruption. This Console never starts or restarts Docker.
sources.stepFour: Append authorized test events after the source is active, refresh, and inspect per-file read/parsed counters. Counters are cumulative; parser totals are engine-wide.
sources.supported: Supported: syslog SSH authentication and Nginx combined access logs. Apache, Docker logs, journald, syslog server, cloud and remote connectors are not implemented. Copying this folder does not migrate engine volumes. There is no silent engine registration or Docker mutation.
sources.platformSupport: Supported: syslog SSH authentication and Nginx combined access logs. Apache, Docker logs, journald, syslog server and Windows Event Logs are not implemented. A Windows path needs an explicit Docker Desktop mount.
sources.selectedOnly: One explicitly selected file. Saving creates configuration only.
sources.paste: Paste an exact file path. No directory browsing, wildcard imports or log-content upload. Docker sees a different container path.
sources.include: Include in the next approved deployment
sources.consent: I authorize JAGRATA to inspect this selected file's metadata and prepare read-only engine access.
sources.privacy: Log files can contain personal data. JAGRATA does not copy file contents. Single-file bind mounts do not follow rotation to a new inode; review mounts after rotation.
sources.saved: Source configuration saved. Engine access is pending operator approval.
sources.validated: Local file validated. Ingestion is not yet verified.
sources.removalNotice: Only the saved configuration changes. The file is preserved. A running engine can continue reading until an operator applies the removal.
sources.removed: Configuration removed. Engine removal requires operator apply.
sources.disabled: Source disabled in configuration. Operator apply is pending.
sources.sshFormat: Syslog SSH authentication records (sshd). Example location: /var/log/auth.log or /var/log/secure.
sources.nginxFormat: Nginx combined access log. Example location: /var/log/nginx/access.log. Custom formats need separate parser validation.
sources.engineWide: Engine-wide; not attributable to this file alone
remediation.description: Review internal decisions and manage local safeguards. No automatic blocking.
remediation.evidence: Alerts describe suspicious behavior. Decisions are internal records. Enforcement:
remediation.empty: No decision records returned in this bounded read. Stored alerts may remain.
remediation.noAdditional: No additional local protections. Built-in local and private ranges remain protected.
remediation.previewDescription: Propose an internal decision for one IP. Protected targets are rejected. Public ownership remains unverified. Applying a decision is unavailable in this release.
remediation.protectNotice: Protect an administrator endpoint, infrastructure address or management CIDR in JAGRATA. This does not synchronize a CrowdSec allowlist.
remediation.disabled: Decision changes and network enforcement are disabled. Preview is recorded; no decision or firewall action occurred.
remediation.saved: Local policy saved. No engine or network change.
remediation.noRetry: No automatic retry. Refresh policy and audit before trying again.
loading.label: Loading engine observations
errors.noSamples: No sample data has been substituted.
errors.refreshHelp: Refresh to request an observation from the configured engine.
errors.stale: STALE observation. Refresh before interpreting engine health.
errors.additional: Additional records exist beyond this window.
errors.truth: Alert times describe stored evidence; LIVE describes a successful current read. JAGRATA does not create decisions or enforce blocks. External enforcement has not been audited.
errors.choose: Choose a page from the navigation.
errors.upstream: CrowdSec observation unavailable. No sample data substituted.
errors.alert: Alert unavailable from the configured engine
errors.metrics: Metrics unavailable; source health is unknown.
errors.engineStopped: Engine stopped. Stored alerts cannot be read until an authorized operator starts it.
remediation.newPreview: Refresh and create a new preview.
sources.removalPending: A removed configuration is still mounted in the current engine. Removal is pending an explicit operator deployment; existing log files are preserved.
preferences.displayOnly: Display preference only. Original evidence timestamps remain unchanged.
preferences.offsetDate: UTC offsets shown for today; displayed timestamps use the offset at the event time.
dynamic.showEvents: Showing {{count}} returned events, capped at 100. Metadata uses a server allowlist.
dynamic.decisionEvidence: This alert records detected behavior. {{count}} decision record(s) were returned. A decision record does not prove that traffic was blocked.
dynamic.revision: Revision {{revision}}. Public management IPs and critical infrastructure must be registered explicitly.
dynamic.auditBound: Showing the latest {{count}} of {{total}} retained records. Capacity 2,000; actions stop when full. Local hash chain detects accidental alteration, not tampering by the host administrator.
dynamic.decisionsUnavailable: Decisions unavailable: {{error}}. No zero count or sample data substituted.
dynamic.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Previously observed data is retained and STALE. {{error}}
dynamic.onlySome: At most the latest 200 local alerts; CAPI alerts excluded.
dynamic.confirmFailure: {{result}}. Refresh and create a new preview.
security.localOnly: JAGRATA-local protection policy only. Not synchronized to CrowdSec AllowLists, parsers or firewalls. Register every public management endpoint and authorized infrastructure CIDR. Public addresses are never assumed safe to block.
security.decisionWindow: Bounded cscli decisions list result; upstream may group decisions by target. Not an exhaustive inventory. Created-at is unavailable for individual decisions; alert time is separate. Expiry is estimated from remaining duration at observation.
security.sameEngine: All sources belong to this installation's single engine. Saving does not change Docker. Changed mounts may require operator-approved recreation of the same service with its existing persistent volumes; this Console never performs it.
security.localAdd: Add a JAGRATA-local protection entry. No CrowdSec allowlist update, alert suppression, decision change or firewall change.
security.localLimit: Protects JAGRATA previews only. External bouncers and CrowdSec detection ignore this local policy.
security.rollback: Deactivate this exact JAGRATA-owned local allowlist entry. Preserve all audit records. No decision deletion or external reversal.
security.rollbackRisk: Removes a local safeguard for future previews. Built-in management protection remains. External enforcement rollback is unavailable.
security.create: Preview only: propose an internal ban decision for this IP. No decision will be created.
security.revoke: Preview only: propose reversal of this exact decision. It is not JAGRATA-owned and cannot be deleted by JAGRATA.
security.publicRisk: Public IP ownership and administrator access are unverified. A public address is not automatically safe to block.
security.enforcementRisk: A decision does not prove network enforcement. No supported enforcement adapter is enabled.
validation.protected: Protected target: local, management, infrastructure or allowlisted range.
validation.preview: Preview unavailable or actor mismatch. Refresh and preview again.
validation.ip: Use a literal IP or canonical CIDR.
validation.hostBits: CIDR must use its network address (host bits must be zero).
validation.mapped: IPv4-mapped IPv6 and embedded IPv4 must use IPv4 literals.
validation.fields: Fields from another operation are rejected.
validation.owned: Only active Guard-created local policy actions can be reversed.
validation.oneIp: Decision creation preview supports a single literal IP only.
validation.exactDecision: Exact current decision ID and target required.
validation.observationTimeout: Decision observation timed out. No automatic retry.
validation.auditFailure: Request failed; durable failure audit unavailable. No engine/network action was attempted. Review local policy storage.
validation.writerBusy: Policy writer busy. No automatic retry.
validation.lock: Policy writer locked. Review state; no automatic retry or stale-lock deletion.
validation.auditCapacity: Audit capacity reached. Preserve and archive offline before further actions.
validation.symlinks: Symlinks and reparse points are not supported.
validation.sourceFields: Unsupported source settings. Arbitrary YAML and commands are rejected.
validation.name: Use a display name of 1–80 characters.
validation.connector: Only SSH and Nginx file sources are supported.
validation.path: Choose one absolute local file path without traversal or wildcards.
validation.windowsPath: UNC, device paths, alternate streams and ambiguous Windows paths are rejected.
validation.inode: Filesystem cannot provide a stable file identity.
validation.fileVerified: Regular local file verified. Contents were not read. Docker access, format and parsing require operator apply and engine evidence.
validation.fileMissing: Selected file is missing or cannot be inspected. Check its exact path and permissions.
validation.configBusy: Configuration writer is busy. Retry later.
validation.configExpired: Configuration write expired. Refresh and retry.
validation.configLocked: Another configuration write is pending. Retry after reviewing the source list.
validation.existingFile: This file already has an acquisition.
validation.existingIdentity: This file identity already has an acquisition (hard-link alias).
validation.sourceLimit: Registry limit reached (64 including retained removal records).
errors.decisionLimit: Too many decisions in bounded response.
errors.policyPath: Policy state must stay below runtime/.
errors.auditDamaged: Audit chain damaged; preserved for recovery.
errors.commitTimeout: Policy operation deadline expired before commit.
errors.publishTimeout: Policy operation deadline expired before publication.
errors.stateMissing: Initialized policy state is missing. No automatic reset.
errors.receiptMissing: Policy initialization receipt missing. Preserved for review.
errors.sourcePath: Source state must remain below project runtime/.
errors.sourcePrivate: Source state directory must be private.
errors.registryDamaged: Source registry is malformed; preserved for recovery.
errors.configRequired: Explicit admin/adapter files and TLS certificate/key required; run bootstrap first.
errors.adminInput: Username 3–64 characters and password 14–256 characters required.
errors.adminPrivate: Administrator file must be a private regular file
errors.adapterPrivate: Adapter file must be a private regular file
errors.nameEncoding: Use a display name of 1â€“80 characters.
errors.noRetry: No automatic retry. Refresh policy and audit before trying again.
securityUi.heading: Shared engine evidence, optional community intelligence and approval-controlled protection workflows.
securityUi.noActivation: Integration plans do not enable CAPI, intercept requests, register components or apply decisions.
securityUi.unavailable: Security observations unavailable. Existing detections remain read-only.
securityUi.noSamples: Security observation unavailable. No sample data substituted.
securityUi.readHint: Read a shared, bounded observation to inspect capabilities.
securityUi.one: One owned engine, multiple log sources. Identity is verified at observation time.
securityUi.rateHint: Rates require two same-process samples. Idle counters do not prove that a source is healthy.
securityUi.noRestart: No restart observed between retained samples.
securityUi.sourceHint: Configured acquisition paths are distinct from JAGRATA-managed registrations. Missing counters remain unknown; no source is silently adopted.
securityUi.noSeries: No acquisition series or inspected file definitions available.
securityUi.noTailProof: Last event timestamp and active-tail proof are unavailable from these counters.
securityUi.nativeHint: Cumulative component-reported values. They do not prove end-to-end enforcement.
securityUi.noMetrics: No metric series observed. No zero values substituted.
securityUi.inventoryDate: Inventory observed {{value}}. Cached for five minutes; no Hub update or installation is performed.
securityUi.profileHint: Profile names are configuration inventory only; notification delivery is not verified.
securityUi.allowlistHint: Engine allowlists are separate from JAGRATA-local protection policy. No synchronization is enabled.
securityUi.notProbed: Not probed; external access requires approval.
securityUi.privacyDisclosure: CAPI and Console may exchange detection IPs, scenarios, timestamps, engine metadata and optional context. Review sharing settings and service terms before registration.
securityUi.noRights: Credentials on disk do not prove remote enrollment, an active subscription or feed redistribution rights.
securityUi.disabledSharing: Stored sharing preferences do not mean sharing is active when CAPI is disabled.
securityUi.noNativeSync: Authoritative CAPI last-pull/error instrumentation is missing from official v1.8.1. No sync time is invented.
securityUi.appsecStages: Rules installed, requests inspected and traffic blocked are separate evidence stages. A bouncer API pull does not prove forwarding.
securityUi.latencyHint: Mean seconds from native histogram sums/counts, when available. No percentile or current latency is invented.
securityUi.componentHint: Registration and last API pull are observations, not proof of enforcement. Docker CrowdSec does not automatically protect the Windows host or LAN.
securityUi.pullHint: Recent means within two minutes of the sample; this is not a configured SLA or live connectivity test.
securityUi.compatHint: Compatibility and integration availability do not mean a capability is enabled. Master-only native changes need an audited stable release or separately reviewed backport.
securityUi.planHint: Prepare a bounded plan. Activation needs a separate exact operator approval outside this browser.
securityUi.planAck: I understand this prepares a plan only and does not authorize activation.
securityUi.planNotApplied: This plan has not been applied. No activation endpoint is available in the Console.
securityUi.keepReceipt: Keep this receipt for separate operator review. It contains no API key.
securityUi.refreshBudget: Observed {{value}}. Shared refresh is limited to one sample per 30 seconds.
securityUi.budgetError: Security request budget exceeded. Wait before refreshing.
securityUi.idempotencyError: Idempotency key belongs to another plan.
securityUi.protectedInventory: Explicit management CIDR inventory required; public ownership is not assumed safe.
securityUi.reasonError: A specific bounded reason is required.
securityUi.sharedRefresh: Shared refresh is limited to one sample per 30 seconds.
securityUi.compiledHint: Compiled support does not prove host access or an active datasource.
